title: Glaphyra Book 1 Adam opening: first man and Christ mystery
english: The first man’s fashioning and fall is told so that the mystery of Christ may be foreshadowed in type — not so that the history is emptied, but so that the end of the Law may be shown.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Lunn FOTC wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
